```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(curl)
library(jsonlite)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

# ---------- UI ----------
pill_html <- function(n) sprintf("<button class='pill'>%s</button>", n)

# ---------- Robust Zotero fetch ----------
read_zotero <- function(url, retries = 3) {
  h <- new_handle()
  handle_setopt(
    h,
    useragent = "Quarto Zotero fetch",
    followlocation = 1L,
    timeout = 30L
  )

  # Zotero returns only 25 items by default. Fetch every page so older
  # publications remain visible as the record grows.
  items <- list()
  start <- 0L
  page_size <- 100L
  separator <- if (grepl("?", url, fixed = TRUE)) "&" else "?"

  repeat {
    page_url <- paste0(url, separator, "limit=", page_size, "&start=", start)
    page <- NULL

    for (i in seq_len(retries)) {
      res <- try(curl_fetch_memory(page_url, handle = h), silent = TRUE)
      if (!inherits(res, "try-error") && res$status_code >= 200 && res$status_code < 300) {
        page <- jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(res$content), simplifyVector = FALSE)
        break
      }
      Sys.sleep(0.5 * i)
    }

    if (is.null(page)) stop("Failed to fetch Zotero data from: ", page_url)
    items <- c(items, page)
    if (length(page) < page_size) return(items)
    start <- start + length(page)
  }
}

zotero_items_url <- function(
  user_id = "6167652",
  collection = "publications",
  item_types = NULL,
  tag = NULL,
  style = "apa",
  sort = "date",
  include = "bib",
  linkwrap = 1,
  v = 3,
  format = "json"
) {
  base <- sprintf("https://api.zotero.org/users/%s/%s/items", user_id, collection)

  params <- list(
    v = v,
    format = format,
    include = include,
    linkwrap = linkwrap,
    sort = sort,
    style = style
  )

  # Zotero OR uses `||`; URLencode will take care of pipes/spaces
  if (!is.null(item_types) && length(item_types) > 0) {
    params$itemType <- paste(item_types, collapse = " || ")
  }
  if (!is.null(tag)) {
    params$tag <- tag
  }

  qs <- paste(
    vapply(names(params), function(k) {
      paste0(k, "=", URLencode(as.character(params[[k]]), reserved = TRUE))
    }, character(1)),
    collapse = "&"
  )

  paste0(base, "?", qs)
}

# ---------- Flatten (your flattener; fixed + quiet) ----------
tl <- function(e) {
  if (is.null(e)) return(NULL)
  ret <- typeof(e)
  if (ret == "list" && !is.null(names(e))) ret <- list(type = "namedlist")
  else ret <- list(type = ret, len = length(e))
  ret
}

mkcsv <- function(v) paste0(v, collapse = ",")

keyListToStr <- function(keyList) {
  paste0("/", paste0(vapply(keyList, function(key) {
    if (is.null(key)) "*" else paste0(key, collapse = ",")
  }, character(1)), collapse = "/"))
}

extractLevelColumns <- function(
  nodes,
  ...,
  keyList = list(),
  sep = NULL,
  mkname = function(keyList, maxLen)
    paste0(if (is.null(sep) && maxLen == 1L) keyList[-length(keyList)] else keyList, collapse = ".")
) {
  if (length(nodes) == 0L) return(list())

  tlList <- lapply(nodes, tl)
  typeList <- do.call(c, lapply(tlList, `[[`, "type"))

  if (length(unique(typeList)) != 1L) {
    stop(sprintf("Inconsistent types (%s) at %s.", mkcsv(typeList), keyListToStr(keyList)))
  }
  type <- typeList[1L]

  if (type == "namedlist") {
    allKeys <- unique(do.call(c, lapply(nodes, names)))
    ret <- do.call(c, lapply(allKeys, function(key) {
      extractLevelColumns(
        lapply(nodes, `[[`, key),
        ...,
        keyList = c(keyList, key),
        sep = sep,
        mkname = mkname
      )
    }))
  } else if (type == "list") {
    lenList <- do.call(c, lapply(tlList, `[[`, "len"))
    maxLen <- max(lenList, na.rm = TRUE)
    ret <- do.call(c, lapply(seq_len(maxLen), function(index) {
      extractLevelColumns(
        lapply(nodes, function(node) if (length(node) < index) NULL else node[[index]]),
        ...,
        keyList = c(keyList, index),
        sep = sep,
        mkname = mkname
      )
    }))
  } else if (type %in% c("raw","logical","integer","double","complex","character")) {
    lenList <- do.call(c, lapply(tlList, `[[`, "len"))
    maxLen <- max(lenList, na.rm = TRUE)

    if (is.null(sep)) {
      ret <- lapply(seq_len(maxLen), function(i) {
        setNames(
          data.frame(sapply(nodes, function(node) if (length(node) < i) NA else node[[i]]), ...),
          mkname(c(keyList, i), maxLen)
        )
      })
    } else {
      ret <- list(setNames(
        data.frame(sapply(nodes, function(node) {
          if (length(node) == 0L) NA
          else if (maxLen == 1L) node
          else paste(node, collapse = sep)
        }), ...),
        mkname(keyList, maxLen)
      ))
    }
  } else {
    stop(sprintf("Unsupported type %s at %s.", type, keyListToStr(keyList)))
  }

  if (is.null(ret)) ret <- list()
  ret
}

flattenList <- function(mainList, ...) do.call(cbind, extractLevelColumns(mainList, ...))

# ---------- Helpers ----------
clean_bib <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("Pat-El, R.,", "Pat-El, R. J.,", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("Pat El", "Pat-El", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("Pat-El, R. J.", "<b>Pat-El, R. J.</b>", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

add_year <- function(df) {
  df$year <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_sub(df$meta.parsedDate, 1, 4)))
  df
}

# Zotero bib is already HTML -> print "asis" via cat()
print_grouped_by_year <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(year)) %>% arrange(desc(year))
  by_year <- split(df, df$year)

  for (y in sort(as.integer(names(by_year)), decreasing = TRUE)) {
    cat(sprintf("<h3>%s</h3>\n", y))
    cat(by_year[[as.character(y)]]$bib, sep = "\n")
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# ---------- Fetch everything once ----------
url_articles  <- zotero_items_url(item_types = c("journalArticle", "conferencePaper"))
url_pres      <- zotero_items_url(item_types = c("Presentation"))
url_books     <- zotero_items_url(item_types = c("book", "thesis", "bookSection", "webpage"))
url_software  <- zotero_items_url(item_types = c("computerProgram")) # Zotero "Software"
url_prof      <- zotero_items_url(item_types = c("magazineArticle"))

df_articles <- flattenList(read_zotero(url_articles)) %>% add_year()
df_pres     <- flattenList(read_zotero(url_pres))
df_books    <- flattenList(read_zotero(url_books))
df_software <- flattenList(read_zotero(url_software)) %>% add_year()
df_prof     <- flattenList(read_zotero(url_prof))

df_articles$bib <- clean_bib(df_articles$bib)
df_pres$bib     <- clean_bib(df_pres$bib)
df_books$bib    <- clean_bib(df_books$bib)
df_software$bib <- clean_bib(df_software$bib)
df_prof$bib     <- clean_bib(df_prof$bib)
```
